mapper.select:
SELECT event_id AS id, instance_id, task_id, number, business_type, node_name, action, operator_id, opinion, event_time, source FROM ( SELECT CONCAT('H:', history.id) AS event_id, history.instance_id, history.task_id, workflow.number, workflow.business_type, history.node_name, CASE WHEN history.cooperate_type = 2 THEN 'TRANSFER' WHEN history.cooperate_type = 3 THEN 'DELEGATE' WHEN history.cooperate_type = 6 THEN 'ADD_SIGN' WHEN history.cooperate_type = 7 THEN 'REDUCE_SIGN' WHEN history.flow_status = 'WITHDRAWN' THEN 'WITHDRAWN' WHEN history.flow_status = 'REJECTED' THEN 'REJECTED' WHEN history.flow_status = 'TERMINATED' THEN 'TERMINATED' WHEN history.flow_status = 'SCRIPT' THEN 'SCRIPT' WHEN history.flow_status = 'TASK_BACK' THEN 'TASK_BACK' WHEN history.flow_status = 'ADMIN_JUMP' THEN 'ADMIN_JUMP' WHEN history.flow_status = 'ADMIN_RETURN' THEN 'ADMIN_RETURN' WHEN history.node_type = 0 THEN 'SUBMITTED' WHEN history.skip_type = 'REJECT' THEN 'RETURNED' ELSE 'APPROVED' END AS action, CASE WHEN history.approver ~ '^[0-9]+$' THEN history.approver::bigint END AS operator_id, NULL::text AS opinion, COALESCE(history.update_time, history.create_time) AS event_time, 'ENGINE' AS source FROM flow_his_task history JOIN t_workflow_instance workflow ON workflow.id = history.instance_id WHERE history.del_flag = '0' UNION ALL SELECT CONCAT('O:', operation.id), operation.instance_id, operation.task_id, workflow.number, workflow.business_type, NULL, operation.action, operation.operator_id, operation.reason, operation.create_time, 'MANAGEMENT' FROM t_workflow_operation operation JOIN t_workflow_instance workflow ON workflow.id = operation.instance_id UNION ALL SELECT CONCAT('S:', execution.id), execution.instance_id, execution.task_id, workflow.number, workflow.business_type, COALESCE(script_task.node_name, execution.node_code), CONCAT('SCRIPT_', execution.status), execution.operator_id, execution.error_message, execution.create_time, 'SCRIPT' FROM t_workflow_script_execution execution JOIN t_workflow_instance workflow ON workflow.id = execution.instance_id LEFT JOIN flow_task script_task ON script_task.id = execution.task_id ) log WHERE 1 = 1
AND (number ILIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR business_type ILIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR node_name ILIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR action ILIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%'))
ORDER BY event_time DESC NULLS LAST, event_id DESC
